counts_note: Counts are per job and per command; reruns are not distinct tests to sum.
limits: Only the pinned commit is qualified, not subsequent uncommitted work.
Rust PyAV remains ignored; public roots smoke is configuration, not a TLS handshake.
Authentication-denial tests use invented local peers, not real revocation or durable provisioning.
No WAN/ASR quality/Android parity/perfection or complete build-environment attestation.
CI executes wire and prefix profiling invariants, not allocation/timing campaigns; Windows local measurements are separate.
Native codec sizing is synthetic; passing tests does not establish real-voice distribution or cache hits at the service.
Raw HPACK privacy is a finite invented S1 loopback fixture; no TLS, CONTINUATION, eviction, table updates, real-service privacy or universal guarantee.

Positive coalescing fixtures preserve default peer limits and original framing tests; the failed70bbCI remains separately recorded, with no historical backlog capture or universal peer-policy guarantee.
No replay of an old client to provoke a failure, and no normal-engine allocation or latency campaign is established.
method: API run/job/step provenance plus command-scoped result rows in raw logs treated only as data
